The manufacturing company [[ChandrilTech]] owned a '''warehouse''' in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Emita/Legends|Emita]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], which was also home to ChandrilTech's [[ChandrilTech headquarters spire|headquarters]]. The warehouse was located near the city's [[Emita Spaceport|spaceport]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The warehouse was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
